name: TIME ARENA
detailed_description:
In Time Arena, time is the ultimate prize. Players battle it out in a futuristic arena where the goal is simple—collect more Clocks than your opponents before time runs out. Speed and strategy are your keys to victory. Use Speed Dash to zip across the map and Ventilator Fans to launch yourself to Main Arena. But be careful, the arena is full of dangers like time-warping grenades and red plasma that can slow you down. Outrace, outsmart, and outlast your friends to prove you’re the fastest in the arena!

Objective

  • Collect more Clock items than your friends before time runs out! Clocks only spawn on the first and top floors of the Main Arena.

MULTIPLAYER

  • In order to play this game, STEAM SHOULD BE RUNNING IN YOUR BACKGROUND!

  • Create a session with Room name, Required players to start and Total gameplay time. Once session is created(it's public by default), your friends could find the game by clicking the "Find Session" button on the mainmenu.

  • Each player’s Steam ID is displayed above their character, and collected Clocks appear at the top-right. Keep an eye on players hoarding Clocks!

Controls

  • W,A,S,D : Basic Movements

  • Shift : Speed Dash (Requires Stamina)

  • 1 key : SMG

  • 2 key : Pistol

  • Right Click : Weapon Aim (Should be equipping weapon beforehand)

  • G key : Plasma Grenade (Reduce the flow of time within a blasted area)

Tips

  • You could use Giant ventilation fans to quickly fly from rear of the map from Main Arena/ground floor from the top level of Main Arena.

  • Plasma Grenades don’t deal damage but slow enemies with a large blast radius. Use them wisely!

  • Red plasma which is coving Ground floor and first floor of Main Arena slowly deals players inside it. Grab a health item to stay alive!

short_description: Get ready for a fast-paced multiplayer TPS shooter, where speed is your weapon and time is your battlefield! Collect objectives before the clock runs out, unleash time-bending power-ups, and outplay your friends. Challenge your friends and dive into the chaos. Time waits for no one!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 12-compatible sound card with 5.1 or 7.1 surround sound support
